reuse: full original historical A02 donor bank, OOF probabilities and residuals
original A02 lexical top-32 source rows and similarities
uniform POS/A02 present blend and existing missing-stream route
fixed_recipe.position_block: existing build_position_block transform; same original A02 vectorizer; REAL original token order; SHUFFLED deterministic per-document order shuffle seed 42 preserving token multiset and third-segment sizes
fixed_recipe.donor_search: top 32 positive K over the complete original bank, ties resolved by stable source row position
fixed_recipe.mass: M0(q) = sum(original lexical top-32 similarities squared); u=K^2; w=M0*u/sum(u)
fixed_recipe.fallback: M0=0 uses exact Sparse25 baseline; missing stream retains exact current A02 probability and threshold 0.53230976129477; M0>0 with no positive K support is an integrity error
fixed_recipe.blend: present stream score = 0.5 * original POS probability + 0.5 * candidate A02 probability; class 1 iff score >= 0.50

views.e67: origin 67, query cycles 68-79; report H12 and W4/W5/W6
views.unique_primary: E67 cycles 68-75 plus E75 cycles 76-79; 20,903 distinct rows; do not duplicate E67 W6

allowed_sources: official Classification Train feature columns for text, cycle, and identity

source_boundaries.query_labels: must not be accessed for construction, selection, or prelabel verification; scoring is allowed only after all four immutable outputs and independent prelabel verification are durable

prospective_scientific_performance_gates.minimum_group_support: n >= 200 and at least 30 examples per class; otherwise UNKNOWN

prospective_exploratory_eligibility.pool_policy: unique-pool gain > 0 OR (E75 W6 gain >= 0.0005 and unique-pool gain >= -0.0005)
prospective_exploratory_eligibility.group_harm: Macro F1 harm <= 0.02 and positive-recall harm <= 0.03 for supported groups
prospective_exploratory_eligibility.status_limit: exploratory-only; never scientific qualification or champion promotion

scope: targeted keyword search across official src, scripts, reports, and experiments for position-aware donor kernels
related_but_not_equivalent: POSOFFSET MIX50 and ADD_RESIDUAL combine existing positional-route and A02 probabilities; they do not condition residual donor retrieval on positional cosine.
CGEOM changes donor geometry by coefficient-weighting bag TF-IDF columns; it does not use token-position blocks.
The positional text pilot adds position-block features to a separate learner; it does not perform position-aware A02 donor retrieval.
novelty_check.limitation: Targeted repository search is evidence against a direct duplicate, not proof that no equivalent exists outside the searched artifacts.
